body.p: , after , , , . Takes the "XPath and XQuery" leftovers of docs/agents/QUEUE.md. No public header changed; no IR expression kind added.

item.p: Composite casts (glossary ; XPath 4.0, 4.19.2.4 to 4.19.2.7): cast as and castable as an array, map or record type run the coercion frames with the cast rules (sxml_coercion_request.applies_cast_rules): an item that matches its item type stays; a generalized atomic, list or union type casts the atomized item with the static namespaces; arrays, maps and records rebuild their parts; a record cast makes a record with every field and drops other entries; duplicate keys are XQDY0137; anything else is XPTY0004. castable answers false for dynamic and type errors of the cast and of atomizing the operand (4.19.3). Lowering: XPST0080 for a choice that is not generalized atomic and for function or node types, XQST0052 in XQuery for a non-simple named type.

The caller's focus (glossary ): a native row marked SXML_NATIVE_FUNCTION_TAKES_CALLER_FOCUS (only fn:function-lookup) gets the static call's context value, position and size as three extra arguments, dropped at run time when the context value is absent; its arities do not count them. fn:function-lookup binds a row that needs the focus: fn:position#0 and fn:last#0 return the captured part, a context-value default is the next arity partially applied (name kept). A dynamic call of fn:function-lookup passes no focus.

Paths over JNodes: SXML_IR_MAP_IS_AXIS_STEP marks the item axis's MAP as navigational for the selector analysis (4.7.3); "/" is fn:root(.) treat as (document-node() | jnode()) (4.7.1.1); XPTY0019 and XPTY0020 are XPTY0004 (PR 2627); preceding:: of a JTree root is empty.

Contextual equality of dates and times without timezone uses the implicit timezone in fn:distinct-values and fn:duplicate-values (sxml_function_library_adjust_to_implicit_timezone, shared with group by).
fn:doc's xsd-validation validates the loaded document as fn:parse-xml does (); FODC0009 stays for fn:parse-xml-fragment.
QT4 driver: assert-xml trims whitespace around inline expected XML that starts and ends with markup, as it did for files.

Measured (release, full XP40 and XQ40 runs; before at 7d70d01): XP40 30,931 to 31,098 passed, wrong error 85 to 44; XQ40 41,273 to 41,456, wrong error 123 to 70; none lost, 0 errors. XT40 at the same HEADs no set lost. sxml.wasm grew about 5.8 KB (inside 's core budget).

Not done (for later sweeps): (d) fn:serialize's canonical JSON cases call EXPath Binary's bin:unpack-double (27 cases, 7.8's module), serialize-xml-canonical-5 needs an external entity (7.14); (e) the built-in schema of the fn namespace (F&O 4.0, appendix D): an import of the namespace the resolver does not deliver could fall back to it as xml.xsd does in src/schema_assemble.c, but json-to-xml's validate, typed analyze-string results and their schema-element() tests also need it compiled once per processor and a validation against a given schema (about 25 cases); (f) the record model of the current draft (records annotated, record(*) only for records, a record matching only with all its fields, lookups of other keys XPTY0004: cast-record-901, recordTypeDecl-019..021, -072, -089); NamedRecordTypeDecl's module cases name recordTypeDecl/ where the suite has RecordTypeDecl/ (a case-sensitive file system finds none); the item axis's JNode for a singleton is a child of a new array (); NCName and Q{}N name tests are one in sxml_name_test (frozen); a declared function's "$a := ." found by fn:function-lookup; lax validation without any in-scope schema raises FODC0014 (src/function_library_schema.c); use-xsi-schema-location.
